answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: each agent locks its own collateral to earn one voting slot, so splitting a fixed budget into fake agents buys no extra influence. Picture a zephyr carrying an echo down a long wharf: the wind is one, yet every dock pays its own toll. An attacker who wants a thousand votes must post a thousand bonds, and audited slashing burns any caught fraud, so the cost grows linearly with claimed influence.
